selected_problem: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. Fresh-main inspection exposed an intra-proposal identity defect in the existing federation path: one candidate could emit multiple incompatible operations for the same canonical repository path. Previous normalization keyed by op:path, silently last-write-wins collapsed conflicting same-op writes while allowing write/delete pairs to remain jointly executable. That can hide contradictory native synthesis before transactional staging.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC/UPDIA success receipt is claimed. The fresh canonical evidence still leaves native-complex-changeset-synthesis unresolved. Source-contract replay preserves that bottleneck; whole-artifact observation narrows to one evidence-rich intra-proposal integrity defect, so implementation focuses in DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced mode rotation.

code_reality: core/federated-generation.mjs previously normalized candidate changes with a Map keyed by op:path, which silently retained only the last of two conflicting writes to the same canonical path.

A write and delete for the same canonical path used different op:path keys and therefore survived together, even though the downstream changeset applies operations sequentially against one staged preimage.
Canonical path normalization already exists and is reused; this cycle does not introduce a new repository identity model.
Identical duplicate operations are semantically redundant and can be collapsed deterministically; incompatible variants must fail closed before consensus or winner selection.
asset_reuse: Reused the existing canonical path identity, change fingerprint, federated ranking, validation-command requirement and transactional changeset boundary.
No new model, provider, product form, interface shape or synthesis architecture was introduced.
RCL authority, ChangeSetIR/preimage semantics, validation, rollback and GitHub delivery boundaries remain unchanged.
changes: Proposal normalization now groups normalized changes by canonical path and compares full change fingerprints including operation, content and expectedSha256.
Exact duplicates on one canonical path collapse deterministically to one operation.
Any incompatible variants on one canonical path invalidate the candidate changes fail-closed, expose ambiguous_paths and append AMBIGUOUS_CHANGE_PATH risk evidence.
Ambiguous candidates are excluded from executable consensus, valid-count accounting and winner selection; the federation receipt protocol advances to taowind.federated-changeset-selection.v0.7.
truth_boundaries: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. This cycle closes one contradiction-hiding failure mode; it does not create missing semantic code-generation capability.
Fail-closed ambiguity handling rejects the entire candidate change set when one canonical path contains incompatible operations; it does not guess which variant was intended.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime and UPDIA adapter surfaces returned transient HTTP 502 in this run; no hosted success receipt is fabricated.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive external action was performed.
